easy_fields.name: WebWalkerQA
easy_fields.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
easy_fields.description: WebWalkerQA is a benchmark designed to assess the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to systematically traverse a website’s subpages to extract high-quality data for complex, multi-layered information-seeking tasks.
